decisions.transports: compiled CLI via `node bin/bb tool bb_patterns`; MCP via StdioClientTransport → src/mcp/server.ts
decisions.corpus: one sub-directory per major language family (Ruby, TypeScript, Erlang, Go, Haskell); every probe recorded
decisions.evidence: every finding must carry non-empty evidence array; orphan findings must derive from canonical detectOrphans

limitations: Only a small sub-directory per repo is indexed (full 29-repo indexing is hours-long); broader coverage is M14.
Framework detection depends on the analyzer assigning framework_type; repos without detectable frameworks skip that class.
